column1: # What the Futamura projection actually BUYS, measured on the covered backend.
# Each total_probe run times the SAME six stimuli twice: `reference-runs` is six
# calls to `interpretDesign`, and `step-runs` is six calls to the specialized
# residual through `stepOf`.  Both are native -O2 Lean in the same process, so
# their ratio is the partial-evaluation speedup and nothing else.
# IT IS NOT an RTL simulation figure, and it is not a comparison against any
# external simulator.  `specialize` is paid ONCE and is reported separately: on
# several designs it exceeds the whole reference run, so the ratio is a
# per-stimulus steady-state figure, not an end-to-end win on a single run.
# Admission for every row is in fp_fileab_canonical_join.tsv / fp_frozen30_seq_join.tsv.
